categories.name: مِنْ قِصَّةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ
categories.nameEn: Key Words from the Story of the Cow in Al-Baqarah

items.verse: قَالُوا۟ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِىَ إِنَّ ٱلْبَقَرَ تَشَـٰبَهَ عَلَيْنَا وَإِنَّآ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَمُهْتَدُونَ
items.verseEn: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is. Indeed, [all] cows look alike to us. And indeed we, if Allāh wills, will be guided."

items.verse: قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌۭ لَّا ذَلُولٌۭ تُثِيرُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَا تَسْقِى ٱلْحَرْثَ مُسَلَّمَةٌۭ لَّا شِيَةَ فِيهَا ۚ قَالُوا۟ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ جِئْتَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ فَذَبَحُوهَا وَمَا كَادُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
items.verseEn: He said, "He says, 'It is a cow neither trained to plow the earth nor to irrigate the field, one free from fault with no spot upon her.'" They said, "Now you have come with the truth." So they slaughtered her, but they could hardly do it.

items.verse: وَإِذْ قَتَلْتُمْ نَفْسًۭا فَٱدَّٰرَْٰٔتُمْ فِيهَا ۖ وَٱللَّهُ مُخْرِجٌۭ مَّا كُنتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ
items.verseEn: And [recall] when you slew a man and disputed over it, but Allāh was to bring out that which you were concealing.

items.verse: فَقُلْنَا ٱضْرِبُوهُ بِبَعْضِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُحْىِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
items.verseEn: So We said, "Strike him [i.e., the slain man] with part of it." Thus does Allāh bring the dead to life, and He shows you His signs that you might reason.

categories.name: عَنَاصِرُ خَلْقِ آدَمَ
categories.nameEn: Elements in the Creation of Adam

items.verse: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ قَالَ ءَأَسْجُدُ لِمَنْ خَلَقْتَ طِينًۭا
items.verseEn: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He said, "Should I prostrate to one You created from clay?"

items.verse: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
items.verseEn: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,

items.verse: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ
items.verseEn: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused.

categories.name: خَصَائِصُ الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Characteristics of Hypocrites in the Quran

items.verse: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ ٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
items.verseEn: O Prophet, fear Allāh and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

items.verse: إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ قَالُوا۟ نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
items.verseEn: When the hypocrites come to you, [O Muḥammad], they say, "We testify that you are the Messenger of Allāh." And Allāh knows that you are His Messenger, and Allāh testifies that the hypocrites are liars.

items.verse: يُخَـٰدِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَمَا يَخْدَعُونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
items.verseEn: They [think to] deceive Allāh and those who believe, but they deceive not except themselves and perceive [it] not.

items.verse: أَفِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَمِ ٱرْتَابُوٓا۟ أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَن يَحِيفَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُۥ ۚ بَلْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
items.verseEn: Is there disease in their hearts? Or have they doubted? Or do they fear that Allāh will be unjust to them, or His Messenger? Rather, it is they who are the wrongdoers [i.e., the unjust].

categories.name: كَلِمَاتٌ فَرِيدَةٌ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Hapax Legomena (Unique Words) in the Quran

items.verse: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ سَبْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
items.verseEn: And We have certainly given you, [O Muḥammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur’ān.
So I swear by the retreating stars -

harf.hint: The state of loss mentioned in Surah Al-Asr, from which only the faithful are exempt

deduction.title: The Crown That Challenged The Skies
deduction.intro: In the corridors of ancient kingdoms, one ruler's name became a byword for tyranny and arrogance. When a humble servant of Allah arrived bearing undeniable signs, this mighty sovereign refused to surrender to the truth. Today, your task is to identify this legendary figure whose dominion crumbled and whose fate was sealed beneath the waves.
clues: I am the most feared ruler whose name still echoes as a warning through the ages.
I commanded an entire people to labor in chains, raising monuments that proclaimed my glory.
When a messenger of Allah came before me with undeniable signs, I refused to bow and called it sorcery.
I decreed the killing of infant sons among a captive people, hoping to crush their spirit before they could rise.
I stood before my court and declared, 'I am your highest lord,' demanding worship as a god.
With my chief minister beside me, I built a towering structure aimed at climbing beyond the heavens.

Perhaps [that] will guide me my Lord

scramble.hint: A famous du'a from Surah Al-Kahf where Prophet Musa (AS) supplicates to Allah for relief and ease
scramble.arabic: إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّى لِأَقْرَبَ مِنْ هَـٰذَا رَشَدًۭا
scramble.verseEn: Except [when adding], "If Allāh wills." And remember your Lord when you forget [it] and say, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to what is nearer than this to right conduct."
